overrideReason: All 3 automated attempts failed on the same gate: 'gates failed: test, US-805-C8'. Investigated directly rather than assuming a repeat of a known pattern. Root cause was a real, live-discovered schema defect in ingest/schemas.py, undiscoverable by codex's own sandbox because it has no live network access (confirmed from attempt 2's own last-message.md, which reports the live DefiLlama integration test failing with httpx.ConnectError there). Running the committed fetcher directly against DefiLlama's real /stablecoinchains endpoint (keyless, no credential needed) surfaced two genuine defects: (1) DefiLlamaStablecoinChain.gecko_id and .token_symbol were typed StrictStr | None with no default, so pydantic required the key to be present (even as null) - but DefiLlama's real response omits these keys entirely for many chains (e.g. Manta, ThunderCore), rejecting every real response outright; (2) DefiLlamaPeggedAmounts.pegged_usd had no default, but chains with no USD-pegged stablecoin at all (only EUR/CHF/VAR-pegged etc.) omit the peggedUSD key entirely rather than sending 0 - and since the response is a list model, one bad entry anywhere in the ~200-chain list failed the whole response, blocking all three tracked chains (ETH/SOL/BNB) even though none of them individually hit either edge case. Fixed both by giving each field a default (None for gecko_id/token_symbol, 0 for pegged_usd) - the 0 default is the true value for a chain with no USD peg, not a proxy for missing data, consistent with this project's never-fake-a-zero rule: a chain that genuinely carries no USD-pegged stablecoin genuinely has a zero USD-pegged supply for that peg type. Re-ran the live fetcher after the fix: all three chains (ETH/SOL/BNB->BSC) now return real, distinct Decimal values (e.g. ETH: 146,343,191,279.12228), and BTC still correctly returns NOT_DEFINABLE. Verified fresh against current HEAD (e63cd602, attempt 3's commit, which independently added the correct registry wiring, offline tests, and board-cell-count updates for the new stablecoin_supply family): npm --prefix web run typecheck clean, npm --prefix web test 53/53 passed, uv run mypy ingest --strict clean, uv run ruff check clean, uv run pytest -q -m "not integration" 330 passed, and the live DefiLlama integration test (tests/test_defillama_stablecoins_fetcher.py::test_live_defillama_request_returns_real_stablecoin_supply_for_one_chain) passes against the real endpoint.

results.note: Live-verified post-fix: fetch_stablecoin_supply('ETH'/'SOL'/'BNB') each return a real, distinct DefiLlamaStablecoinSupplyOk with a real Decimal peggedUSD value from DefiLlama's live /stablecoinchains endpoint (chains Ethereum/Solana/BSC).

fetch_stablecoin_supply('BTC') returns Error(NOT_DEFINABLE) naming DefiLlama's own /stablecoinchains chain list having no Bitcoin entry - confirmed by direct code review and tests/test_defillama_stablecoins_fetcher.py::test_btc_returns_not_definable_with_defillama_chain_list_reason, and the detail text is distinct from US-804's BNB ETF-flow absence reason.

The fetcher only ever calls /stablecoinchains, never /stablecoin/{id} - confirmed by direct code review of ingest/fetchers/defillama_stablecoins.py and tests/test_defillama_stablecoins_fetcher.py::test_fetcher_never_calls_defillama_per_asset_stablecoin_endpoint.
DEFILLAMA_SOURCE_FIELD explicitly states 'totalCirculatingUSD.peggedUSD (USD-pegged only)', confirmed by direct code review and the registry.yaml source_field entry.

grep confirms exactly one stablecoin_supply entry in ingest/registry.yaml (definable_for: [ETH, SOL, BNB], not_definable: [BTC]) - no global/total stablecoin-supply key exists anywhere in the registry.

DefiLlamaStablecoinChainsResponse uses extra="forbid" on DefiLlamaStablecoinChain; a reshaped/malformed response is rejected - confirmed by test_response_model_rejects_added_renamed_or_retyped_fields and test_malformed_response_becomes_fetch_failed_error.

tests/test_defillama_stablecoins_fetcher.py::test_live_defillama_request_returns_real_stablecoin_supply_for_one_chain re-run fresh against current HEAD with the schema fix applied: PASSED against the live endpoint, returning a real positive Decimal value for Ethereum.

`uv run pytest -q` (equivalently -m "not integration" per pyproject.toml addopts) re-run fresh against current HEAD plus the schema fix: 330 passed, 55 deselected, exit 0. mypy --strict and ruff both clean. npm --prefix web test: 53/53 passed.

note: All 8 criteria independently verified. This story's real path to done required fixing a genuine schema defect that none of the 3 automated attempts could discover, because DefiLlama's real /stablecoinchains response omits keys for many chains in ways the offline test fixture (which had all fields present) never exercised, and codex's own sandbox lacks live network access to hit the real endpoint at all. Exactly the class of finding this project's discipline of live-testing before trusting a fixture exists to catch - the same pattern already seen in US-802 (FRED revision-vintage assumption) and US-804 (SoSoValue float-vs-string, undeclared field).
